violation_type.title: Training Criteria - Evaluation Tool (26 TAC §746.1317(c)(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: The training certificates for the infant caregivers did not have an evaluation tool to determine the acquired knowledge.

finding_variants.text: The training certificates for the infant caregivers did not have an evaluation tool to determine the acquired knowledge.
Three personnel files reviewed did not have the assessment tool for several training certificates.

Based on the information obtained from the investigation, The certifications of training given by the director were reviewed and determined not compliant when there was no training assessment documentation completed by the staff members for review during the investigation.
All the training certificates reviewed did not have an assessment tool to determine the information acquired from the training topics.
